subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace skill diagnostics be accepted as a lint-only command first, or must the existing skills status/list/Web surfaces also expose skipped candidates before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The source issue asks for normal CLI and Web visibility, while the open candidate currently centers on `skills lint`; repository policy treats this as a product surface choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Require existing-surface diagnostics
options.body: Treat the issue as complete only when skipped-candidate diagnostics reach the existing status/list surfaces, with lint as an additional helper.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Land or revise the open lint command as a first step and keep a separate follow-up for status/Web diagnostics.

options.title: Accept lint-only completion
options.body: Declare a dedicated validation command sufficient after the open PR lands and close the broader visibility request then.

recommendation.title: Require existing-surface diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat the issue as complete only when skipped-candidate diagnostics reach the existing status/list surfaces, with lint as an additional helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on the skills CLI, parser, and recent loader surfaces and can decide the user-facing diagnostic contract.
